text.en: Respiratory and metabolic acid-base disorders are distinguished by how severe they are, not by their underlying cause -- in reality, they are distinguished by which side of the carbon-dioxide/bicarbonate balance is disrupted first: a respiratory disorder originates with abnormal carbon dioxide levels from a ventilation problem, while a metabolic disorder originates with an abnormal bicarbonate level or acid load from a cause entirely outside the lungs; severity is a separate axis from this categorical distinction.
text.et: Respiratoorseid ja metaboolseid happe-aluse häireid eristab see, kui rasked need on, mitte nende aluseks olev põhjus -- tegelikult eristab neid see, kumb pool süsihappegaasi/bikarbonaadi tasakaalust esimesena häiritakse: respiratoorne häire saab alguse ebanormaalsest süsihappegaasi tasemest ventilatsiooniprobleemi tõttu, samas kui metaboolne häire saab alguse ebanormaalsest bikarbonaaditasemest või happekoormusest põhjusest, mis on täielikult väljaspool kopse; raskusaste on sellest kategoorilisest eristusest eraldiseisev telg.
